scope: Static source assessment only; no runtime/import/collector/target validation. No GitHub review or environment skip.
result: Existing arbitrary-target transparent-asyncio launch route is documented and implemented; it preserves target source bytes but is an in-process observer with semantic and scheduling perturbation. Legacy install-in-loop helper is not the only route.
result_zh: 已有文档及实现的transparent-asyncio任意目标启动路径，保留目标源码字节，但属于进程内观察器，会改变运行时与调度，并非无扰动认证；旧install-in-loop helper不是唯一入口。
launch_argv_status: Exact documented example, statically inspected only; placeholders are not a verified command for any frozen case. Target argv forwarded after --; controller script uses system python3.

implementation.entry: bin/corostitch -> scripts/corostitch.py -> PYTHONPATH agents/python -> sitecustomize -> corostitch_agent.install
implementation.target_bytes: No rewrite or target import statement inserted. cwd forced repository ROOT, env/import path changed; relative-input/cwd equivalence must be checked for a future original. -S/-I/-E or custom sitecustomize/import/loop behavior can bypass assumptions.
implementation.kwargs_factory: Launch BaseEventLoop.create_task wrapper forwards *args/**kwargs to original, preserving its existing factory handling. Remote-only loop factory forwards **kwargs to prior factory/default Task. Explicit context/name forwarding absent in old python_asyncio_debugger two-arg wrapper; do not substitute it on that basis. Forwarding alone does not prove all CPython3.13 patch/eager/custom factory compatibility.
implementation.version_dependencies: Default launch agent/CLI helpers use stdlib imports in inspected source. CPython3.13 is not rejected by launch source and argv can select a matching interpreter; no runtime readiness certified. Remote branch actually accepts version strings starting Python3.14, despite3.14+ error wording; not usable as3.13 remote route. Optional unawaited warning hook uses private CPython warnings API and origin tracking/GC; optional boundary spec uses profile hook and may import SQLAlchemy.
implementation.identity: Task weak keys map actual Task address to a monotonic generation suffix. Segments use monotonic_ns and current observation nativeTID; creator is tracked current Task at post-create observation, not resource owner. Eager-completed Task may be observed after it executed. Direct Task construction/custom create_task overrides may evade BaseEventLoop patch. Process/interpreter metadata needed when joining graphs.
implementation.sampler: Default general agent adds call_later TimerHandles, no sampler Task or new thread in inspected default path. Reads await chain/get_stack on event-loop callbacks; suspended-state snapshots, not per-Task CPU samples. Busy loop delays observer itself; short originals may finish before first tick.
implementation.cleanup_perturbation: Done callback records return/cancel/exception, clears active/base/latest, weak Task map avoids permanent strong retention. Reading task.exception can change unretrieved-exception reporting. No pending-Task destruction retirement guarantee. atexit flush is not assured after hard kill; opt-in unawaited capture also forces GC. Remote detach restores its stored factory and removes callbacks, not proof of all multi-loop cleanup.
implementation.graph: graph.json plus PID-scoped helper graphs; CLI summary/report. Internal graph conservation is observed coverage, not independent Task census. Ordinary launch can return0 with no graph because no required graph failure branch; do not accept CLI exit alone or stale output as capture proof.
implementation.ownership: Default lifecycle/snapshots do not establish pipe/queue/socket/resource ownership, true running-Task CPU binding, admission/wait cause or timer attribution. USDT converter only thread/function stacks.

wave37: All three unique named Python anchors have unchanged SHA256 since snapshot37. Broader runner/agent inspected here was outside that snapshot row; no claim that the repo previously lacked it.
future_first_run_rule: Only for a genuinely new, gate-cleared original within its original clock: establish compatible interpreter/dependencies and source/argv/cwd invariants, then consider the existing launch route before the single first run.

Use capture only when its in-process hooks, factory/kwargs behavior, TimerHandle sampling, cleanup, child output and shutdown behavior fit that original. Source availability alone is not readiness or nonperturbation certification; do not execute unneeded probes.

Use fresh unique output and verify actual graph metadata/coverage, target stdout/stderr, exit/kill/handles and original bytes. --seconds does not bound this launch; preserve original workload with authorized external supervision if necessary.

If optional capture remains unready or changes the authorized protocol, a feasible unchanged native-only first run remains allowed with explicit capture gap. Never replay any of the ten frozen successes for backfill, controls or profiler evidence.
future_first_run_rule_zh: 仅对全新且当前门禁通过的原例，在原时钟内先确认匹配环境、原源码/argv/cwd及hook扰动边界，再考虑已有启动采集路径并仅执行首次原例。必须验证新graph及覆盖/退出/清理；源码存在或CLI exit0不代表采集成功。可选采集未ready时仍可忠实native-only并说明缺口；十项冻结成功原例均不重跑补采集。
parent_scope_addendum: No native readiness, child-process behavior, graph coverage or semantic transparency is certified. Inherited environment, per-process output selection and cross-process joins require verification in a future genuinely new original. Ten frozen successes are never replayed to fill these gaps.
